config.prompt: When loyalties conflict, the Code reads as a process — order it:
items: Consider the least-restrictive option that protects the client's interests and the worker's legal position
config.why: Ethical decision-making in social work IS that process — because the dilemmas are genuine, not oversight. The reasoning must be reviewable by supervisors, boards and courts afterwards.

activities.anchor: If that were true, codes would be short
activities.caption: find the faulty line — the code audited
activities.name: swCodeSpot

config.prompt: One line of this summary of the Code's function is wrong — click it:
lines: Confidentiality against protection is a genuine conflict of obligations.
Loyalty to the client against loyalty to the agency is a genuine conflict.
For every situation there is one rule — the professional's job is to find and apply it.
The Code structures which duties rank above which, in which circumstances.
Real codes are long precisely because obligations conflict.
config.correction: The Code is a process, not a lookup table — it structures the reasoning and makes it reviewable, because the duties genuinely conflict.
config.why: If lookup were true, codes would be short and the work mechanical. The trained response is a documented process instead.

statements.s: Rural workers typically practise as generalists — one worker covering casework through community organising.
statements.why: With the ethical wrinkle of dual relationships: clients are also neighbours.

statements.s: Urban settings allow specialisation and referral but concentrate caseloads.
statements.why: The trade is real on both ends of the map.

statements.s: Dual relationships are an urban phenomenon, since cities are anonymous.
statements.why: It is the rural setting where clients are also neighbours — the wrinkle travels with the generalist.

statements.s: The generalist is a dilettante across all three sizes of system.
statements.why: One worker who can judge at which level intervention will actually help — and who understands how a change at one level ripples into the others.

config.prompt: Two postures toward the same client — drag the divider:

before.label: Case management of people
before.text: Method without empowerment: goals in the agency's vocabulary, plans that treat the client as a passenger — practice that fails even when it achieves its goals.

after.label: Partnership practice
after.text: Goals in the client's own words, plans built on existing strengths — the relative who helps, the faith community, the hard-won sobriety — and advocacy that aims at the client's own voice.

config.why: The worker brings methods and access; the client brings irreplaceable expertise about their own life. Empowerment without method becomes goodwill without results — the synthesis needs both.

activities.anchor: modern practice texts read like a marriage
activities.caption: the method debate — take a position, see the consequence
activities.name: swEvidenceBranch

config.root: You are designing help for a chaotic, multi-problem family. The profession's live debate offers three postures — follow each:

choices.label: Only interventions with empirical support
choices.feedback: The cognitive-behavioural therapies lead the evidence tables — but randomised-trial evidence underrepresents exactly the chaotic, multi-problem populations social work serves.

choices.label: The relationship carries the outcome
choices.feedback: Decades of psychotherapy research find the alliance among the strongest predictors of outcome across methods — but goodwill without method becomes goodwill without results.

choices.label: Both/and
choices.feedback: The working synthesis: evidence-supported methods, delivered through a deliberately built alliance, evaluated continuously.

evidence.text: Disciplined judgement, Richmond-style — at its best when the alliance is built alongside it; brittle when the relationship is treated as a delivery vehicle.

alliance.text: The settlements' human solidarity — powerful and real, and stronger still when it carries a method with evidence behind it.

synthesis.text: Choose evidence-supported methods, deliver them through a deliberately built alliance, and evaluate continuously.

config.why: Which is why the methodological debate is a live one, not a settled slogan — both parents of the profession still speak in it.
